newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold prices firm on new year demand.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold prices firm on new year demand.

text.p: Prices rose slightly on the Istanbul gold exchange on Tuesday and volume remained high compared with last week on physical demand, dealers said.
Gold closed at $369.40 an ounce, up from $369.10 on Monday, and at 1,237,500 lira per gram versus the previous 1,236,000.

"Traders moved to close positions as physical demand began to emerge ahead of near year jewellery sales. For this reason, prices rose, despite the generally depressed market and the expectation of future price falls," one dealer said.
Volume fell to 740 kilos from 922 on Monday, but was stronger than last week's 328 kilo daily average.
Morning turnover was 455 kilos, with 83.8 percent of all trade in lira.
